content.title: Wright State University Admissions 2026: Eligibility & Application Process
content.text: University ranking The ranking of Wright State University in the 2022-2023 list of National Universities by U.S. News is #331-440. According to U.S. News, the university has been ranked #353 for Top Performers on Social Mobility, and #169-227 in Top Public Schools. The Times Higher Education US College Ranking is >600th for 2022. Acceptance Rate The admissions process at the Wright State University is less selective, with a fall 2021 acceptance rate of 96%. Half of the applicants admitted to Wright State University have an ACT score between 17 and 24, and an SAT score between 955 and 1245. Admission eligibility criteria In order to get admission into the Wright State University, the candidates need an ACT composite score of at least 15. The candidates need an average SAT score of 1130. The candidates need a cumulative GPA (Grade Point Average) of 2.5 on a scale of 4.0. The applicants need to meet English Language Proficiency Test requirements if they are from non-English speaking countries. Documents required A non-refundable application fee of $40 must be submitted to the university. A copy of the applicant’s passport information page showing their name, photo, and date of birth must be submitted to the university. An official confirmation of the applicant’s bachelor’s degree must be submitted to the university. The proof of English Proficiency Test scores must be provided by the applicants. The official GRE and GMAT scores must be submitted to the university. The applicants need to provide their official bank statement for financial proof and financial support. A statement of objectives must be submitted by the applicants, if required. Tests required SAT/ACT tests English Proficiency Test (IELTS: 6 or higher, TOEFL: 79/120, Pearson PTE: 57 or higher). GRE (Graduate Record Examinations) test GMAT (Graduate Management Admission Test) GPA (Grade Point Average) score of 2.5 on a scale of 4.0. Popular courses Registered nursing Mechanical Engineering Psychology Computer and Information Science Business Management and Business Administration Biology Commerce/Business Marketing Management Finance How the university evaluates applicants The applicants are evaluated on the basis of their overall academic performance. Therefore, the university considers the High-School performance of the applicants based on their GPA. The personal statements of the candidates are also evaluated by the university during the time of the application. Tips for applying to the University With a 96% acceptance rate, Wright State University is almost an open admission school, and nearly all the applicants are admitted. Therefore, the most important requirement for the applicants is to submit their documents on time. Application deadline The application deadline to apply to the Wright State University is August 23.
